key_insight: Two-level overlapping Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW and RGDSW coarse spaces remain robust for high-order 2D FEM/VEM Poisson solves, while RGDSW cuts coarse-space size substantially.
engineering_relevance: These preconditioners support scalable high-order discretizations by improving solver robustness and reducing coarse-problem cost in large finite element and virtual element simulations.
method: Use additive Schwarz with overlap and a two-level coarse correction.
Compare GDSW against reduced GDSW coarse spaces for conforming Pk and Qk FEM.
Extend the same preconditioning strategy to polygonal-mesh VEM in 2D.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical condition-number bounds and numerical tests on structured triangular, quadrilateral, and polygonal meshes up to polynomial degree k=9, with RGDSW reducing coarse dimension by about 3x while keeping competitive iteration counts.
watch_item: Performance is shown for selected polynomial orders and 2D Poisson problems, so behavior on more complex PDEs, 3D geometries, or less favorable mesh/interface conditions may require additional validation.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 2D
